ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of an insect life cycle, with green arrows connecting different stages. The position labeled C on the left is a group of eggs; the position labeled A near the top is an immature insect/nymph; the position labeled E at the bottom is a winged adult; the position labeled F on the right shows an insect coming out from an old shell or exoskeleton, with a form like a shed shell next to it. Reasoning: molting refers to an insect shedding its skin, that is, taking off the old exoskeleton or shell. In the figure, only F clearly shows the process of the insect emerging from the old shell, so the stage indicating molting is F.
